### Give God Your Best Work
Author: Whitney Hopler
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/give-god-your-best-work-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Colossians 3:23-24
Points:
- Daily work of any kind is meant to be an act of worship rather than a pursuit of money or human praise.
- Wholehearted labor honors God because believers are ultimately working for an eternal Master who sees all things.
- Faithfulness in ordinary, unseen tasks is never wasted and can yield lasting fruit in God's timing.
- Serving Christ frees us from the pressure to please people or depend on earthly recognition.

### The Most Important Reason We Work
Author: Phillip Holmes
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/the-most-important-reason-we-work
Passage: Colossians 3:22-24
Points:
- God designed humanity to work in His image, making purposeful labor a gift rather than a curse.
- Working merely for human approval leads to insincerity and slacking off whenever people are not watching.
- Believers are called to work for the Lord, motivated by His character and commands rather than an earthly boss's flaws.
- Knowing we are already accepted in Christ empowers us to do our best for an audience of one.
